name: Select
description: Dropdown picker that renders a styled native select with chevron icon, label, helper text, and error state.

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }>

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder option shown when no value is selected

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the selected option value

snippets.webcomponent:
<!-- Arrays must be set via JS property, not HTML attribute -->
<cl-select label="Choose" placeholder="Select..."></cl-select>

<script>
  const sel = document.querySelector('cl-select');
  sel.options = [
    { value: 'a', label: 'Option A' },
    { value: 'b', label: 'Option B' },
  ];
  sel.addEventListener('change', (e) => console.log('selected:', e.detail));
</script>
